primary_family_source: Stage05E1 primary <=250 bp replicated architecture families
e2a: at least one E1 internal edge jointly supported by a D1-999-family-exclusive exact-primary canonical repeat core and a D1-999-family-exclusive compact FAM50 cluster
e2b: no E2A edge, but at least one E1 internal edge jointly supported by a D1-999-family-exclusive qualifying canonical repeat-core string (exact or approximate-description) and a D1-999-family-exclusive compact FAM50 cluster
e2c: family has at least one family-exclusive repeat-core string or compact FAM50 cluster, but no jointly supported internal edge
e2d: no family-exclusive repeat-core string and no family-exclusive compact FAM50 cluster under the frozen audit definitions
family_exclusive_definition: all observed occurrences in the global Stage05D1 999-candidate audit universe are contained within the E1 family, with support in >=2 distinct sequence IDs
claim_boundary: E2 specificity/topology is an architecture-review layer. Family-exclusive evidence means exclusive within the frozen Stage05D1 audit universe under the stated representation, not globally unique in nature. It does not establish RT activity, ncRNA function, or ART identity.
